# CMFM menu interface header

- `include/cmfm/cmfm.h`: `cmfm.menu` 1.2, copied unchanged from CMFM commit
  `95a0ffae2a3a2aa2433435839988b242e094053d` (2026-10-12; the header of the
  0.1.0 release), `include/cmfm/cmfm.h`, SHA-256
  `63ac08e2b562d84214b10a64f301d210b3f5410130b807d0f707c60b8cb15263`.
- Licence: MIT, `LICENSE` (copied from CMFM).
- CMFM is optional for cpuopt: without it, players edit `cpuopt.ini`.

Update it only by copying a newer release's header and recording the commit
and hash here. Interface 1.2 is frozen; later CMFMs keep accepting 1.2 pages.
